title: Collapsible sidebar navigation for an app
when: The user wants a vertical app or dashboard sidebar with sections, icons and a way to collapse it.
prompt:
Goal: A sidebar that keeps the current place obvious, collapses to icons on demand and becomes a panel on phones.
Steps:
1. Shell grid with grid-template-columns: var(--side, 15rem) 1fr; the sidebar is <nav aria-label="App"> with links holding an aria-hidden icon and a text label.
2. The current link gets aria-current="page" plus a bar or background.
3. Groups use <button type="button" aria-expanded aria-controls> to show or hide their nested <ul>.
4. A collapse <button type="button" aria-pressed> sets data-collapsed, narrowing the sidebar to 4rem; labels become visually hidden, never display: none.
5. Save the collapsed state in localStorage inside try and catch.
6. Below 720 px open the sidebar from a Menu button as an overlay panel that Escape closes.
Quality bar:
- Every item keeps an accessible name in every state.
- The main area reflows instead of being covered.
- Keyboard order follows the visual order.
Pitfalls:
- Storage that throws in private mode and breaks the script.
- A fixed column that squeezes content on tablets.
- Hover only flyouts for the collapsed state.
Verify:
- [ ] The sidebar is a nav with an aria-label.
- [ ] aria-pressed and aria-expanded match the visual states.
- [ ] Collapsed state survives a reload.
- [ ] The panel opens and closes at 375 px.
Output: Shell markup, sidebar.css and sidebar.js loaded with defer.

examples.input: sidebar recolhivel para meu painel admin
examples.output: nav aria-label App with Orders, Products, Reports group, collapse button with aria-pressed saved in localStorage
